summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_secret and client_id; profile built from mapped fields, profile args, auth_type oauth, and env-var references). Registered it directly after the token mapping in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py and added it to both package export lists. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claiming, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection, profile output, auth/secret override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run, per the instructions; verification was by reading the base class code.
